kai: Heads-up: bringing up new qbringup runs (qbench-v3) this afternoon. Need a curated candidate pool + golden refresh. Target ~110k candidates, golden 2k. Can we momentarily freeze label ingestion to avoid stale labels?

remy: timeline? i can coordinate dedupe and label freeze. recommend embed-cluster -> fuzzyhash chain to reduce paraphrase collisions.

ina: agree. propose steps:
- 12:45 UTC: start embed-cluster prune (faiss hnsw, nlist=1024)
- 13:10 UTC: fuzzyhash sweep (th=0.81)
- 13:40 UTC: export 4k quickcheck sample (stratified by intent/lang/len)
- 14:00 UTC: run int4 vs qint8 comparators on 2k golden
If good, we'll promote int4 artifact.

curation-ops: noted. label-bot will pause ingestion for "curation" at 12:50-14:30 UTC. i'll requeue any batches with >20% incomplete.

label-bot: label ingestion paused at 12:50 UTC (automated). React :white_check_mark: to resume.

remy: dedupe config:
```
pipeline: embed-cluster -> fuzzyhash
embed_params: {index: hnsw32, cosine_th: 0.875}
fuzzy_th: 0.81
shards: 120
```
outputs to s3://rwd-curation/qbench/v3/dedupe-2026-03-22

kai: perf-bot, please attach token-cost estimate and p95 latency estimate for the run (120k samples). abort criteria: >2% drop on precision/recall on golden OR p95>400ms.

perf-bot: est tokens ~25M, compute est $380, p95 est 320ms (int4). qint8 fallback est $520.

ina: i'll run the quickcheck spotcheck and post top 30 diffs. remy please pin runtime image and disable autoscaling for determinism.

remy: pinned rwd-infer:2026-03-15-int4, autoscale off. starting pipeline now. will only post blockers.

kai: thanks — keep thread dry during run. i'll publish go/no-go after the eval CSV.
